provider: MLIT / prefectural authorities via GSI Hazard Map Portal
coverage: Provider coverage varies. Offline: z11–12 Kobe region and z13 central Kobe; parent tiles used beyond packaged detail. 352 tiles available, 248 provider-unavailable in explicit 600 tile sample.
limitations: Maximum-scale flood scenarios, storm surge and tsunami inundation, and statutory landslide warning zones are separate datasets, not a combined risk score. No colour does not mean safety. Source dates and assumptions differ. Official source legends bundled.
